# Babilônia Productions

> A production company based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. We produce film and
> photography campaigns end to end — concept, casting, locations, crew, shoot
> and delivery — for brands and agencies, in Rio and across all 26 Brazilian
> states. The team works in English and Portuguese.

- Website: https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/
- Based in: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
- Works across: all of Brazil
- Languages: English, Portuguese (pt-BR)
- Contact: contact@babiloniaproductions.com · +55 21 97743-3092 (WhatsApp)
- Founded: 2024
- Portuguese version of this site: https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/pt/

## Services

- [Campaign Production in Rio de Janeiro](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/campaign-production/): Full-service campaign production in Rio de Janeiro and across Brazil: concept, casting, locations, crew, shoot and delivery for global brands and agencies.
- [Production Services & Fixer in Brazil](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/production-services-brazil/): Local production service for international crews shooting in Brazil: crew, casting, locations, permits and logistics from a Rio de Janeiro production company.
- [Fashion Shoot Production in Rio de Janeiro](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/fashion-production/): Fashion campaign, lookbook and e-commerce production in Rio de Janeiro for global labels: casting, locations, styling and crew, from Ipanema to favela rooftops.
- [Photo Shoot Production in Rio de Janeiro](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/photo-production/): Commercial and lifestyle photo shoot production in Rio de Janeiro: photographers, casting, locations, styling and crew for brand campaigns across Brazil.
- [Film & Video Production in Rio de Janeiro](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/video-production/): Campaign film, music video and branded documentary production in Rio de Janeiro and across Brazil, shot digitally or on 16mm, with stills from the same crew.
- [Music Video Production in Rio de Janeiro](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/music-video-production/): Music video production in Rio de Janeiro and across Brazil for artists, directors and labels: concept, styling, art direction, dancers, locations and crew.
- [Casting in Rio de Janeiro & Brazil](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/casting/): Model and street casting in Rio de Janeiro and across Brazil: agency talent and real people found in the community, for campaigns, films and photo shoots.
- [Location Scouting in Rio de Janeiro & Brazil](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/location-scouting/): Location scouting, access and permits in Rio de Janeiro and all 26 Brazilian states, from Ipanema and Urca to the favela rooftops most productions never find.
- [Remote Production in Brazil](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/remote-production/): Shoot your campaign in Brazil without flying a team: we cast, scout, style and shoot in Rio while you direct remotely, with stills and video from one crew.
- [Community Projects & Small Events in Rio](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/services/community-projects/): Production for small, community-based projects in Rio de Janeiro: artists' social projects, intimate shows and get-togethers, with access and local partners.

## Selected clients

Nike, DSQUARED2, Coolway, Farm, Havaianas, Arezzo, Dazed, Latin Recording
Academy. 30+ campaigns produced in Brazil.

## Work

- [ProStandard — NFL × Flamengo, Idea to Production in Seven Days](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/prostandard-flamengo/): An NFL × Flamengo collection for ProStandard, built around the one question every carioca was already asking — American football or futebol — and shot across the real Rio seven days after the first conversation.
- [Magali Pascal — Alegria, Found in Rio](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/magali-pascal/): A Bali-based luxury boutique launches ALEGRIA in Rio: elegant, sexy imagery shot across Ipanema, the Centro Histórico, and Urca — and a collection that sold through fast.
- [Floyd — Bringing the Mojo Back, SS26](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/floyd/): Floyd's campaigns are all about "bringing the mojo back". For this one, we set up a chessboard on Ipanema beach and shot the whole thing on 16mm film.
- [Nike × NOCTA — Cardinal Stock Summer 2026](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/nike-nocta/): We helped produce Nike's NOCTA Cardinal Summer campaign in Rio. Cast straight from the favela, no agencies, no model cards.
- [Soli&Sun — The Bag in Rio](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/soli-sun/): A full production built around one accessory: the bag. We brought it to the most iconic places in Rio, as travelers would in the city.
- [Ernest Leoty — SS26](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/ernest-leoty/): A location-driven shoot built around Rio's own textures: sun-bleached rock, tree cover, and open sky standing in for a studio.
- [Casa Rosa — Rio Campaign](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/casa-rosa/): A dreamy, nature-driven campaign for Casa Rosa shot on the quiet side of Rio, vintage silhouettes set into the sand, rock, and greenery of Praia Vermelha and Flamengo.
- [Coolway — Rio Campaign](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/coolway/): A footwear campaign for Coolway shot across Rio, from the Copacabana seawall to a neighborhood soccer court.
- [Dsquared2 — SS26 Swimwear & Underwear Campaign](https://babiloniaproductions.com/preview/pr-31/work/dsquared2/): A nighttime SS26 swimwear and underwear campaign shot across Rio's Babilônia favela, heat, boldness, and a setting no studio could replicate.

## Frequently asked

### What does Babilônia Productions do?
We are a production company based in Rio de Janeiro. We produce film and photography campaigns end to end — concept, casting, locations, crew, shoot and delivery — for brands and agencies, in Rio and across all 26 Brazilian states.

### Where are you based, and where can you shoot?
Our base is Rio de Janeiro and we produce across all 26 Brazilian states. Wherever the shoot lands, we arrive knowing the ground — the streets, the people, who to ask for access, and how long the move between two points really takes.

### Do you work with international brands and agencies?
Yes. Most of our work is for brands and agencies outside Brazil, among them Nike, DSQUARED2, Coolway, Farm, Havaianas, Arezzo and the Latin Recording Academy. The team works in English and Portuguese.

### Can you act as our production service or fixer for a shoot in Brazil?
Yes. If you arrive with your own director or creative team, we handle the ground: crew, casting, locations and access, logistics, and the problems nobody planned for.

### Do you shoot stills as well as film?
Both, usually on the same production. Most of our campaigns deliver motion and stills together, from one crew, rather than two separate bookings.

### How long does a production take?
It follows the project, not a template: we have turned a production around in a single day, and we have built others over months. Speed is real here — our NFL × Flamengo capsule for ProStandard went from the first conversation to the camera rolling in seven days. So is the opposite. When a campaign is built for impact rather than volume, we give it the prep and the detail it asks for.

### How do we start?
Email contact@babiloniaproductions.com or message us on WhatsApp with whatever you have — a brief, a moodboard, or just a date and a rough idea. We come back with an approach and a budget.
